name: FRONTEND_PORT
detail: 8070. Host HTTP port for the nginx frontend.

name: BACKEND_PORT
detail: 4004. Host port mapped to the API container port 4004.

name: POSTGRES_PORT
detail: 5433. Host port for the bundled database; backend containers use DB_PORT 5432.

name: KAFKA_PORT
detail: 9092. Host Kafka listener; internal clients normally use kafka:29092.

name: KAFKA_UI_PORT
detail: 8085. Optional Kafka UI host port, enabled by the tools profile.

name: MQTT_PORT
detail: 1884. Development anonymous MQTT host listener, mapped to broker port 1883.

name: MQTT_WS_PORT
detail: 8884. Development MQTT over WebSockets host listener, mapped to 9001.

name: MQTT_AUTH_PORT
detail: 1885. Authenticated plain MQTT host listener.

name: MQTT_TLS_PORT
detail: 8885. Authenticated TLS MQTT host listener, mapped to broker port 8883.

name: POSTGRES_USER
detail: postgres. Database account passed as DB_USERNAME to the backend and worker.

name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
detail: Required site secret. Replace the example placeholder; never use change-me in a real installation.

name: POSTGRES_DB
detail: proact. Database name passed as DB_NAME.

name: DB_MIGRATIONS_RUN
detail: true for the API by default; worker is fixed false. Use a single migration owner.

name: DB_RLS_TENANT_BINDING
detail: true. Bind authenticated requests to their permitted tenant context. Keep enabled.

name: DB_HOST
detail: postgres in the standard Compose stack. External database overrides change this. Use the hostname resolvable from inside the API and worker containers.

name: DB_PORT
detail: 5432. Database service port inside the container network.

name: KAFKA_BROKERS
detail: kafka:29092 in the standard stack. Comma-separated broker endpoints where applicable.

name: MQTT_URL
detail: mqtt://mqtt:1883 in the development stack. This is the shared runtime broker setting; individual intake connections have their own broker configuration.

name: JWT_SECRET
detail: Required unique long random access-token signing secret. Example guidance recommends at least 32 random characters.

name: JWT_REFRESH_SECRET
detail: Required separate long random refresh-token signing secret. Must differ from JWT_SECRET.

name: AUTH_ALLOW_PUBLIC_REGISTRATION
detail: false. Keep false; use bootstrap for the first administrator and authorized user administration thereafter.

name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
detail: Empty falls back to JWT_SECRET. Configure and protect a stable secret for encrypted connector credentials.

name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEYS
detail: Optional named key ring in id:secret,id2:secret2 form; secrets at least 16 characters according to the configuration example. Use the supported rotation procedure.

name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_ID
detail: Identifier of the named key used for new encrypted values. Leave empty with the key ring when using the single-key configuration.

name: EXPORT_TTL_HOURS
detail: 168. Hours a completed export remains downloadable.

name: CORS_ORIGIN
detail: http://localhost:8070 by default. Comma-separated permitted browser origins for direct backend calls; normal frontend traffic uses the same-origin proxy.

name: PI_SERVER
detail: Runtime nginx /piwebapi proxy target, passed to the frontend service by Compose. Set to the site's actual PI Web API endpoint; it does not configure each backend PI connection. The repository contains a development endpoint, not a new-plant default to reuse.

name: CONNECTOR_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST
detail: Empty means unrestricted development egress. Set permitted source hosts and optional ports for a site; wildcard subdomain syntax is documented in .env.example.

name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
detail: /api for a same-origin container build. Build-time setting; do not put a relative /api override into the root development .env unless the development proxy is configured accordingly.

name: PROCESS_ROLE
detail: api for the API service, worker for the worker service; all is supported outside the split Compose deployment. Fixed per service, not selected by the root .env.

name: PORT
detail: 4004 inside the API container.

name: WORKER_PORT
detail: 4005 inside the worker container for health probes; not exposed as the business API.

name: BACKEND_URL
detail: http://backend:4004 in the standard frontend container. Runtime nginx proxy target.

name: CLIENT_MAX_BODY_SIZE
detail: 25m in the frontend image. nginx upload request limit; backend validation also applies. A different value requires a frontend service environment override; the standard Compose file does not read this key from root .env.

name: EXPORT_STORAGE_DIR
detail: /app/storage/exports. Private storage mounted into both API and worker. Keep separate from public assets.

name: AUDIT_REQUEST_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
detail: 30 in Compose. Retention for request audit logs. Runtime unset/empty means keep forever, but Compose's :-30 interpolation substitutes 30 for an empty root .env value; disabling it requires an explicit service environment override. A configured value must be a whole number of days >=1.

name: AUDIT_TRAIL_RETENTION_DAYS
detail: 30 in Compose. Retention for the append-only audit trail. Runtime unset/empty means keep forever; an empty root .env value still selects Compose's 30-day default. Use an explicit service environment override to disable.

name: RAW_RETENTION_DAYS
detail: 365 in Compose. Raw observations are removed by eligible whole monthly partitions. Runtime unset/empty means keep forever; an empty root .env value still selects Compose's 365-day default. Use an explicit service environment override to disable.

name: SAMPLE_RETENTION_DAYS
detail: 90 in Compose. Measurement samples are removed by eligible whole monthly partitions; signal summaries remain. Runtime unset/empty means keep forever; an empty root .env value still selects Compose's 90-day default. Use an explicit service environment override to disable.

name: RETENTION_BATCH
detail: 1000 in Compose. Row deletion batch size for retention work.

name: DB_USERNAME
detail: Mapped from POSTGRES_USER in Compose. For a direct Node deployment, set the backend database account explicitly.

name: DB_PASSWORD
detail: Mapped from POSTGRES_PASSWORD in Compose. For a direct Node deployment, provide the database secret securely.

name: DB_NAME
detail: Mapped from POSTGRES_DB in Compose; proact is the data-source fallback.

name: DB_LOGGING
detail: Enabled only when exactly true. Diagnostic SQL logging setting; do not enable casually on a sensitive or busy site. Optional runtime key: set in the API/worker service environment or direct Node process; standard Compose does not forward it from root .env.

name: DB_POOL_MAX
detail: 10 runtime connections by default per process; non-positive or non-integer input falls back to 10. Optional runtime key: configure the API/worker service environment explicitly; standard Compose does not forward it from root .env.

name: DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS
detail: 30000 milliseconds in long-running API/worker connections by default; non-positive or non-integer input falls back to 30000, so 0 does not disable it. Migration CLI connections do not inherit this statement timeout. Configure the service environment explicitly; standard Compose does not forward this key from root .env.

name: DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
detail: 10000 milliseconds by default; non-positive or non-integer input falls back to 10000. Configure the API/worker service environment explicitly; standard Compose does not forward this optional runtime key from root .env.

name: DB_SLOW_QUERY_MS
detail: 500 milliseconds by default; threshold for slow-query warnings. Non-positive or non-integer input falls back to 500. Configure the API/worker service environment explicitly; standard Compose does not forward this optional runtime key from root .env.

name: EXPORT_PDF_FONT
detail: Optional path to a TrueType font available inside the process for PDF glyph coverage, including Persian text. Mount the font and configure the relevant API/worker environment explicitly; standard Compose does not forward this key from root .env.

name: EXPORT_PDF_FONT_BOLD
detail: Optional corresponding bold font path; falls back to EXPORT_PDF_FONT when not supplied. Mount the font and configure the service environment explicitly. Verify generated PDFs with the actual configured fonts.

name: BCRYPT_ROUNDS
detail: Bootstrap and seed-script hashing default to 10 when absent. This is not a global override of every authentication/user service. For container bootstrap, pass it explicitly to that process; standard Compose does not forward it from root .env.
